Builder rules
Keep measured ETF leadership, equal-weight baskets, cohort rotation, taxonomy and research scores distinct. Ratio returns use %. Arithmetic differences use percentage points. Missing values never become zero. Historical membership and available-at clocks cannot be inferred from today's configuration.
Reuse existing producers, auth, routes, source lineage and save owners. Bind Company through D07's canonical analysis route and preserve exact listing, region, universe, filters, date, scroll and focus on return. Do not add a second lifecycle or provenance store.

Desktop 1024 / 1280 / 1440 / 1600; tablet 768; phones 320 / 390. Light and dark, EN and ZH. Keyboard, focus, touch, reduced motion, table alternatives and independent source freshness.
